criteria.name: Non-text content
criteria.evidence: source and DOM: two spans with a border, no role, no label, no hidden text
criteria.note: Heal (a11y): role="status" with a visually hidden "Loading" text, or aria-hidden when the caller announces loading itself.

criteria.name: Keyboard
criteria.evidence: axe and keyboard run: an animation with no interactive element, Tab finds nothing to focus

criteria.name: Pause, stop, hide
criteria.evidence: source: a loading indicator, shown only while loading (essential motion)

criteria.name: Focus visible
criteria.evidence: axe and keyboard run: an animation with no interactive element, Tab finds nothing to focus

criteria.evidence: axe and keyboard run: an animation with no interactive element, Tab finds nothing to focus

criteria.evidence: axe and keyboard run: an animation with no interactive element, Tab finds nothing to focus

criteria.name: Consistent help
criteria.evidence: page level: the component offers no help mechanism

criteria.name: Redundant entry
criteria.evidence: flow level: the component asks for no data

criteria.evidence: flow level: the component is not part of a login step
